message.content:
This magazine cover for "TEMPO" features an illustration of four caricatured people with oversized heads inside a small orange inflatable boat. A man on the left, wearing a yellow shirt and glasses, reaches out with both arms. In the center, a woman with glasses and brown hair smiles, her hand raised near her chin. To the right, a man wearing a black cap and green shirt holds a white packet with an orange stripe. A fourth man is visible behind them.

The boat floats on dark, murky water from which numerous human hands reach upward. Floating debris, including several white and orange packets, a bottle, a tin can, a fish skeleton, and a blue shark fin, surround the boat. The background shows dark silhouettes of rooftops beneath a blue sky with white clouds. Bold yellow text across the foreground reads "KAMPANYE DI AIR KERUH?". Additional text includes "Bongkar-Pasang di Sekretariat Negara" at the top, "EDISI 4 - 10 Februari 2002," "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," and "Rp 14.700." A barcode and "ISSN 0126 - 4273" are located in the bottom left corner.
